title: Factorization of a product over sign cubes
statement: Let $d$ be a natural number, and for each coordinate $i<d$ let $g_i$ be a real-valued function of two signs. If $x$ and $y$ are chosen independently and uniformly from the sign cube $\{\pm1\}^d$, then the expected value of $\prod_{i<d}g_i(x_i,y_i)$ equals $\prod_{i<d}\mathbb E_{a,b}g_i(a,b)$, where each pair $a,b$ consists of independent uniform signs.
hypotheses_covered: For each coordinate $i<d$, a function $g_i\colon\{\pm1\}\times\{\pm1\}\to\mathbb R$
